deploy-bot: STAGED ROLLOUT STARTED: service=redwood-inference-api version=1.9.2 -> 5% traffic (eu-west). change window=23:00-02:00 UTC. ops@, @maya please monitor. rollout_id=rl-2315800000 :rocket:

maya: on it, watching latency + error-rate dashboards. will call stop/go at 5% check-in.

sara: quick FYI — seeing a small uptick in 5xxs from embed-worker in eu-west from 23:04:10. +0.4% baseline -> +1.5% now. digging logs.

josh: any correlation with recent model quant change? we pinned model variant earlier to v2-quant, right?

ryan: yes, rollout config shows model_pin=v2-quant for this release. no other infra changes in that zone.

maya: checking traces and p99. latency looks stable, but error-rate > threshold (1%) on /v1/embeddings endpoint. holding for now. please do not advance to 20%. @deploy-bot hold. :hand:

deploy-bot: ROLLOUT HOLD acknowledged for rl-2315800000. current traffic 5%. pausing progressive shift.

sara: logs show stacktrace from embed-worker: "KVCacheMissException" + OOM warnings just before spike. sample log:
```
2026-05-10T23:04:09Z embed-worker-3 ERROR KVCacheMissException: missing key for model v2 quant
2026-05-10T23:04:09Z embed-worker-3 WARN memory.free low: 78MB
```

josh: that aligns with batch size bump we merged in 1.9.2. could be memory regression under certain seq lengths.

maya: decision: rollback eu-west to 1.9.1 for safety. initiating pin to 1.9.1 and aborting further percent increments. will run canary rollback then sweep. @ryan please stand by to approve rollback job.

ryan: approved. run rollback job.

deploy-bot: ROLLBACK STARTED for rl-2315800000 -> target_version=1.9.1. rolling back canary instances in eu-west.

maya: once rollback completes, I'll run a quick smoke: healthcheck, embeddings sanity, and replay 100 sampled requests.

sara: after rollback starts I'll keep checking logs for residual OOMs. if anything persists we escalate to runtime team.

deploy-bot: ROLLBACK COMPLETE for rl-2315800000. all eu-west nodes now on 1.9.1. traffic back to baseline.

maya: verified: error-rate back to 0.3%, p50/p90 latency nominal. marking this rollout as paused and rolled back. Action items: 1) revert batch size change in 1.9.2 branch and open a regression PR; 2) run memory stress tests for v2-quant; 3) reschedule canary after fixes. I'll post a short release note update.

josh: thanks team. logging postmortem and adding test to catch KV cache miss pattern. :white_check_mark:

ryan: noted for changelog and release tracker.

maya: closing thread, will follow up with RFC for safer canary config (smaller batch, earlier memory alarms)"
